description: This file contains a Python implementation of a test server, including server classes, request handlers, and utility functions for testing network interactions and server behavior.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base exception class for the module.

classes.name: OptionError
classes.description: Exception class for command line option errors.

classes.name: FileMultiplexer
classes.description: Handles writing to two file descriptors simultaneously.

classes.name: ClientRestrictingServerMixIn
classes.description: Mix-in class to restrict server connections to a specific IP.

classes.name: BrokenPipeHandlerMixIn
classes.description: Mix-in class to handle broken pipe and connection reset errors gracefully.

classes.name: StoppableHTTPServer
classes.description: HTTP server subclass that can be stopped cleanly.

classes.name: BasePageHandler
classes.description: HTTP request handler class with support for multiple handlers and request types.

classes.name: TestServerRunner
classes.description: Class to run and manage the lifecycle of the test server, including options and startup notification.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages to standard error.

methods.name: MultiplexerHack
methods.description: Creates a FileMultiplexer or returns log_fd directly if std_fd is invalid.

methods.name: log_request
methods.description: Overridden to disable request logging for decluttering.

methods.name: _ShouldHandleRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request path matches a handler based on its name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for running the server, parsing options, and starting the server.

methods.name: create_server
methods.description: Abstract method to create server instance, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: run_server
methods.description: Runs the server loop, handling shutdown on KeyboardInterrupt.

methods.name: add_options
methods.description: Adds command-line options for server configuration.

methods.name: _notify_startup_complete
methods.description: Sends startup completion data to parent process via pipe.
